No Git is benign only when no .git metadata exists; existing metadata without Git fails. Declare external volumes through public Compose ports and keep inherited setup separate from official agent wall time.
Use dependency-only seeds and independent equal-start arm cache clones; freeze execution inputs and copied evidence instead of mutable workspace metadata. Snapshots001/002 were unpaid.
Distinguish admission from actual wire-dispatch attempts, hold unknown usage and stop; scan reflected secrets before streaming bytes, including cross-chunk matches.

Preserve the primary failure when result/native files are absent; never invent trajectories or zero usage. Existing invalid files stay strict and all-role totals must not be replaced by main-only counts.

A past full suite covers its stable source snapshot only; later changes require their own evidence. Faster single observations and official metrics without valid F2P/P2P groups cannot satisfy dual improvement.

Prior successful host qualification does not guarantee later repository/network availability. Inspect setup/agent/verifier and valid trial count: framework exit0 or mean0 cannot turn an install error into an RC-off score. Preserve failure; changed setup wiring requires a new immutable source freeze and equal arm conditions before a same-sample retry into a new output directory.

A host application-level direct positive control is distinct from container or system-proxy reachability. Setup-only egress must use an authenticated disposable route, validated before installation, scoped through the original public environment interface, restored after success/error/cancel, and closed externally before model phase. Offline scope checks cannot prove actual network or installation success.

Idle CONNECT upstream timeout must close its client too. Preserve the reproduced old failure, then prove both sides and active sockets settle while the whole proxy remains open. A minimal later transport fix uses explicit incremental evidence and must not inherit a claim that full installation was rerun afterward.

Transparent egress sniffing can reject explicit setup CONNECT before the host proxy. Use public network only around the unchanged installer, keep scoped auth proxy, finally restore relay-host-only and check before any model.
A proxy407must advertise Proxy-Authenticate Basic so default Gitlibcurl can negotiate. Curl CLI success alone is not Git installer success; preserve failed setup and actual Git auth proof.

OverlayFS can returnEXDEV renaming a lower-layer.git directory within the same apparent filesystem. Opaque copy backup before deletion, rollback on failure, delete backup before model, and prove the actual image path rather than relying on host Git tests.
